# packages

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/internal/domains/packages"
```

Package packages implements the Package resource domain.

The Package domain is responsible for managing the lifecycle of Package resources. It receives commands from the Engine, resolves resource specifications into validated contracts, delegates processing to the application layer, and records reconciliation outcomes through conditions and events.
